messages.subject: bug in error generator
parts:
Back on stan-dev:

On 5/17/12 1:10 PM, Daniel Lee wrote:
> Btw, I just found a bug in the generator. I've fixed it and will push
> it this afternoon.

Thanks for the heads up. I shouldn't be touching
the generator until you push.

> It had to do with the string function__ in write_csv. Boost uses "%1%"
> for arguments to their string formatter. It was written out as "%1"
> (missing the second "%").

I can believe that. A lot of the execution
paths haven't been tested.

That's why it's so good you're running so many
different kinds of models.

- Bob
